id.description: Globally unique identifier for this vote.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Vote" for Vote entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this vote record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this vote record was last updated.

decisionId.description: Identifier of the decision this vote participates in.

memberId.description: Identifier of the member who cast or owns this vote.

value.description: Vote value recorded for the decision, such as an implementation-defined choice or consent signal.

previousRevisionId.description: Identifier of the previous revision of this vote, if this vote amends an earlier vote.
